upload_diff_to_codereview: upload diffs from git, mercurial, or subversion to the codereview.appspot.com code review server
generate_diff_with_vcs: generate a diff against a specific revision using the --rev option with git or subversion
authenticate_with_clientlogin: authenticate with Google ClientLogin to obtain auth tokens and cookies for the review server
upload_base_files: upload base files for binary or image files so the server can display side-by-side diffs
encode_multipart_form_data: encode form fields and files into multipart/form-data format for HTTP POST requests to the server
